Hi Alex — great to meet you virtually. Following up on Jordan's notes:

- SOC 2: We do not yet have a full SOC 2 Type II report, but we have a SOC 2 readiness assessment completed (controls mapped, third-party audit firm engaged). Estimated audit window: Q2 2027. I've attached a short readiness summary that outlines scope and expected timeline.

- Incident Response & Breach Notification: Attached is an excerpt from our Incident Response Playbook detailing detection, escalation, and notification flows. Our contractual breach notification target is within 72 hours of confirmed material data incidents; for regulatory obligations we coordinate per affected jurisdiction (we can include specific HIPAA/GDPR clauses if needed).

- Vendor Questionnaire: Jordan — please share the vendor questionnaire or link and we'll begin populating. Alex — if you have a preferred format (PDF, OneTrust, or spreadsheet), send it over and we'll prioritize.

Happy to set a follow-up with Laura (head of security ops) if you want a deeper walkthrough next week.

Best,

2) For breach notification, the 72-hour target is acceptable as a contractual baseline. Can you confirm the escalation path (who are the contacts) and whether Redwood will support forensic evidence collection if needed?
3) Vendor questionnaire: attaching our standard security questionnaire (vendor_security_questionnaire_FintechCorp.xlsx). Please populate sections on IR, data retention, encryption, and subprocessor list.

Alex — thanks for the questionnaire (received). Quick responses inline: 

- Scope: We will confirm formal scoping in the questionnaire, but the planned SOC 2 scope includes customer data storage and processing (embeddings and inference logs) for hosted and dedicated deployments. We will flag any exclusions (e.g., customer-managed on-prem configurations).

- Escalation & forensic support: Our IR process includes a named incident commander and a security ops team that will support evidence collection and post-incident forensics. We can include a point-of-contact template in the questionnaire (name/email/phone). For contractual language, we can commit to reasonable assistance for forensic investigations; anything requiring law enforcement or subpoenas will follow legal processes.

- Turnaround: 5 business days is reasonable. We'll prioritize IR, data retention, encryption, and subprocessor sections and return a draft by Tuesday, Dec 8.

I'll attach the two artifacts we discussed for your records.

Cheers,
Marissa
